Undergraduate Admissions
Applying to SMU Lyle is the first step in making your college experience one that defines your future success. We carefully consider the total profile of a student that balances achievement in a variety of areas, not just test scores.

We consider the quality of your high school curriculum and whether you elected to take more challenging courses. Work experience counts too! We look for creativity, leadership and community involvement. In short, we seek academically-able students who possess a variety of skills, talents, perspectives and life experiences.

Accelerated Pathways
Maximize your future options by earning a Lyle Engineering master’s degree.
Earn both a bachelor’s and a master’s degree in less time than completing the degrees separately.
Start exploring this option in the spring of your sophomore year and apply before reaching 90 credit hours.
Begin taking graduate-level coursework that will be applied to both the bachelor’s and master’s degrees (up to 9 hours).

Application Requirements
All graduate applicants are required to submit:
Completed online application
Official transcripts from all colleges and universities attended
English language proficiency test scores or an approved waiver, if applicable
$75 application fee
Additional requirements for Ph.D. applicants:
Three letters of recommendation
GRE scores
Résumé or CV
Statement of purpose
Master’s applicants may also submit for consideration:
Three letters of recommendation
GRE scores
Résumé or CV
Statement of purpose
SMU’s school code for GRE scores is 6660.
Additional requirements may vary by program. Review your program page for program-specific application requirements.You can view your programs specific requirements in the most current SMU course catalog.
For specific questions about your program of interest, please contact the appropriate program director or email lylegrad@smu.edu.

Domestic
SMU Lyle brings together leading experts to carry out cutting edge research and education. Our faculty are widely regarded as some of the nation’s best instructors and mentors.
Want more information?
For further information or questions concerning the graduate admissions process, contact our Office of Graduate Admissions at 📧lylegrad@smu.edu.
Weekend Format
Graduate programs currently offered in Weekend Format include Manufacturing Leadership and Innovation, Engineering Management, and Systems Engineering.
Classes are held every other Friday, in the DFW area. Classes are completed in 5 sessions.
Cohorts start in the Fall, typically the first Friday in August.
Priority application deadline for Weekend Format is May 15; final deadline is August 1.

English Language Proficiency
English Language Proficiency Requirements
One of the following tests must be submitted and must meet the outlined minimum score:
TOEFL (pre-2026): 80 out of 120
TOEFL (2026 an onward): 4
PTE: 55
IELTS: 6.5
Duolingo: 110
Home-based tests are also eligible upon approval
English Language Proficiency Waivers
A student may waive English Language Proficiency Requirements if the student received a bachelor's or master's from an English Language Institution located in, or have citizenship from: United States, American Samoa, Australia, Bahamas, Barbados, Beliz, Canada (except Quebec), Dominica, Ghana, Grenada, Grand Cayman, Guyana, Ireland, Jamaica, Kenya, Liberia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Singapore, South Africa, Trinidad/Tobago, Turks and Caicos Islands, United Kingdon, or U.S. Pacific Trust.
Applying through Global Education Institute
Applying through Global Education Institute
The longstanding strategic partnership between SMU Lyle School of Engineering and the Global Education Institute (GEI) provides admission processing services for international students. These services include the following:
Pre-Master Program (PMP), which is available to all international students. As a matriculation pathway program, PMP offers international students intensive Academic English courses, as well as courses from SMU Lyle. It accepts students based on existing admission standards. This program makes it possible for international students who do not currently have standardized test (e.g., TOEFL, GRE) scores to have the opportunity to demonstrate their academic abilities required to be successful at SMU Lyle.
Assistance to international students in direct admission applications. GEI’s qualified and knowledgeable staff is experienced in assisting students who need additional information on SMU Lyle’s master’s degree programs.
Processing GEI student’s tuition payment. Tuition payment processing through GEI is free of charge, so the tuition amount remains the same as listed on SMU Lyle’s website. This service provides great convenience for international students.
Visit the Global Education Institute website for additional information regarding this partnership, or contact Jason Li at jason@elinc.edu
